The code wheel layout reads the game's 13 answers, and each rune tile is its original rune
The Enhanced code wheel appears at the prompt, refuses a wrong word, can be put away and brought back, opens as a tool after start-up without a key reaching the game, and Classic is unchanged

Enhanced shows the game's own runes, cell for cell as Classic does, at the five places the game writes Espruar or Dethek for the player to translate; the frame names each rune; no narration covers a rune instruction; and the game takes SHESTNI, NOKNOK and RHODIA typed where it asks. With POR_GAME_SOURCE=port it runs the shipped game from game/, whose font is blank, and requires the wheel's picture of each rune in its cells

The table the page draws runes from names each of the wheel's 70 rune pictures once, each read as its letter at the translate position; the game's 13 start-up questions draw the wheel's runes; the scripts' rune strings spell LUX, SAMOSUD, SHESTNI, HARASH, RHODIA and NOKNOK; and, with the original files, every glyph of the game's rune font is its picture pixel for pixel

The acceptance harness and its party-care helpers on the game itself: prompts, dice trace, position, a fight by the game's own commands; then what the game offers a party: the Camp menu (no Fix), the cleric's spells in memory, the temple's price and refusal, the trainer's 1000 gp refusal, buying from pooled money
New Phlan walkthrough scenarios on the game itself: Rolf's tour, City Hall and the clerk, the dock, the temples, the tavern and the city watch

Slums walkthrough scenarios on the game itself: the entry from New Phlan, the fight with the orcs at location 1 fought with the game's own commands, their scroll readied and read (with the messages the game flashes on the bottom line), the five flee squares, and the goblin armsmaster at location 2 after healing in camp with the cleric's spells and bashing the locked door; and, with the party the Lee guide tells a player to make, the armsmaster again with all six standing and 90 experience points each and his Leather Armor +1, the stable's leather bag, the secret treasure room, the feeding kobolds and the Bracers AC 6, the hobgoblins and their gold with the Ring of Protection +1, and the cleric trained to level 2 for 1000 gold pieces; then the orcs' home with its Chain Mail +1, the guards at (0,7), the monster leaders, the goblin guards and the chest they guarded with its Shield +1

The party the Lee guide tells a player to make, built from nothing through the game's own menus (Create New Character, Add, Modify to the game's ceilings, the arms shop, the inn, spells memorised, Save), each sheet read back with View, and compared with the saved game in qa/fixtures/guide-party-new-phlan

Three dynamic narration families driven on the game itself until they fire several times, each firing required to select a variant: the tavern tale number, the four training halls, the Slums' random encounters
